games.title: After Stream

games.description: A long solo journey through Nerea’s nightmare. Sark searches the city and sewers, survives the haunted houses and forest maze, reaches the party, and battles the timed driving finale across repeated attempts. The successful run was recorded during a Discord stream and later replayed on this Twitch stream, with the ending and his reactions preserved.

games.description: Three solo visits to the hand-drawn shooter. Sark previews the opening and combat simulator, returns to finish the first mission, then revisits the game after off-stream progress to play more missions, challenge objectives and the final boss ending.
games.title: KINGDOM of the DEAD

games.description: Sark investigates room 34, photographs paranormal changes and searches for a combination. The exorcism’s symbolic card choices lead to repeated guesses and a final failed attempt before he leaves the investigation.
